# Countersign

> Spending mandates for AI agents. USDT settles on Whitechain Sepolia testnet (chain ID 1874); a Mandate smart contract enforces the owner's limits; payments above a threshold need World ID human approval; the agent identity is agent1.countersign.eth on ENSv2 (Sepolia). Testnet development preview, not for real funds.

## How it works
- Owner creates a mandate: per-transaction limit, period budget, approval threshold, allowed merchants, attestor.
- Agent signs the exact payment intent (amount, merchant, order). The agent holds no USDT and no gas.
- Relayer + GasGuard simulate and submit `pay()`; the contract checks signatures, payout, limits, nonce, expiry and pause, then moves USDT or reverts.
- Over the threshold, the owner completes a fresh World ID sign-in and wallet signature; a separate attestor co-signs; the contract verifies both.
- ENS text records mirror the policy; a live drift check compares ENS with the contract (MATCH/MISMATCH).
